DRAFT 1 — On Systems Thinking

Everyone's obsessed with habits.

Wake up at 5 AM.
Cold shower.
Journal 3 pages.

Me?
I just want my tools to talk to each other.

Kanban feeds StoryGen.
StoryGen feeds the Hub.
The Hub feeds my morning brief.

I don't remember to check things.
The system reminds me.

Discipline is overrated.
Systems are forever.

DRAFT 2 — The $9K Truth Nobody Shares

"Must be nice."

That's what people say when they hear $9K/month.

They don't see:
- The Estonian tax forms
- The server that went down at 2 AM
- The API that broke everything
- The mental load of 3 revenue streams

But here's the thing.

I'd still pick this over a 9-5.

Not because it's easier.
Because it's mine.

Ownership > Comfort. Always.
